channel.title: N&D Co. Blogs
channel.description: Insights, quick tips and plain guides from N&D Co., a brand and growth agency in Kolkata, on branding, websites, SEO and marketing for growing businesses.

item.title: The Fiverr fake order scam: a case study of the files, pages and card form
item.dc:creator: Nakshatra Ranjan Saha
item.description: Seven new Fiverr accounts claimed an order and sent .html and PDF files. We read the code: fake Fiverr pages ending at a bank card form, and where to report it.

item.title: How accessible are US small business websites? A study of 385 sites
item.dc:creator: Nakshatra Ranjan Saha
item.description: We tested 385 US small business homepages: 87% had a serious or critical WCAG failure, dentists 96%, low contrast 60%. Common errors, fixes and the law.

item.title: White label SEO explained: how agencies resell SEO safely
item.dc:creator: Nakshatra Ranjan Saha
item.description: White label SEO explained: how reselling works, NDAs, who owns the accounts and the link spam risk. We read 16 provider sites; only 3 publish a monthly price.

item.title: NDAs, IP and ownership when you outsource to an agency
item.dc:creator: Nakshatra Ranjan Saha
item.description: Who owns outsourced code? US work for hire, UK and Indian copyright law, why an Indian assignment needs a period and territory, and what your NDA must cover.

item.title: 12 restaurant ad ideas, with food ads from our own work
item.dc:creator: Nakshatra Ranjan Saha
item.description: One dish, one price, one button: 12 restaurant ad ideas with eight food ads our team designed, the image sizes Meta and Google recommend, and a checklist.

item.title: Shopify development in India: what partners charge, from Shopify's own directory
item.dc:creator: Nakshatra Ranjan Saha
item.description: We read 160 Shopify Partner Directory profiles: India-based partners start a store build at a median $500, US-based ones at $1,150. Prices, tiers, tips.

item.title: How do you hire a WordPress developer in India? What 30 agency websites show
item.dc:creator: Nakshatra Ranjan Saha
item.description: We read 30 Indian agency websites: 22 offer WordPress, 4 publish an hourly rate, 8 say you own the code. What to ask and put in writing before you hire.

item.title: Food logo ideas: what the logos of 50 big restaurant chains tell a small food business
item.dc:creator: Nakshatra Ranjan Saha
item.description: We studied the logos of the 50 largest restaurant chains: 62% use red, 34 are lettering only. Restaurant, cafe and eatery logo ideas, with our own examples.

item.title: How to choose an SEO agency in India: what 37 agency websites show
item.dc:creator: Nakshatra Ranjan Saha
item.description: We read the websites of 37 Indian SEO agencies: what they charge clients abroad, who promises rankings, who sells links and what to check before you hire.

item.title: The Quatgio email: a fake client brief that ends at a fake Google sign-in
item.dc:creator: Nakshatra Ranjan Saha
item.description: An email from quatgio.com offered us a client project, then sent a booking link that leads to a fake Google sign-in. What it looks like and what to do.

item.title: Arabic websites in Dubai: what 40 agencies offer, and what bilingual costs
item.dc:creator: Nakshatra Ranjan Saha
item.description: Of 37 Dubai agency websites we could read, 20 say they build Arabic sites but only 7 have an Arabic version themselves. Prices, bilingual costs, a checklist.

item.title: Logo file types: which format to use where
item.dc:creator: Nakshatra Ranjan Saha
item.description: Logo file types explained: SVG, PNG, JPG, PDF, AI and EPS, vector vs raster, logo sizes, and the files in a real package we delivered, with their sizes.

item.title: What do Google Play and the App Store require from a business app in 2026?
item.dc:creator: Nakshatra Ranjan Saha
item.description: What Google Play and the App Store require from a business app in 2026: developer accounts, D-U-N-S, 12-tester closed testing, privacy forms and review times.

item.title: How much does SEO cost in India in 2026?
item.dc:creator: Nakshatra Ranjan Saha
item.description: SEO cost and price in India in 2026: monthly charges from 108 agency websites, what a fee covers, red flags, GST and how to compare quotes.

item.title: How do you optimize content for LLMs?
item.dc:creator: Nakshatra Ranjan Saha
item.description: What Google, OpenAI, Anthropic and Perplexity say about their crawlers, robots.txt, llms.txt and content, and how to check your own site for AI search.

item.title: How do schools and colleges do SEO?
item.dc:creator: Nakshatra Ranjan Saha
item.description: How schools, colleges and coaching institutes get found on Google: admission and fee pages, a Business Profile per campus, titles, reviews and language pages.

item.title: How healthy are Kolkata small-business websites? We checked 901 businesses
item.dc:creator: Nakshatra Ranjan Saha
item.description: Half of 901 Kolkata businesses on Google Maps have no website. We checked the rest: dead links, missing basics, local markup and mobile speed, 30 October 2026.

item.title: What Indian agencies charge in 2026: prices from 108 agency websites
item.dc:creator: Nakshatra Ranjan Saha
item.description: What Indian digital agencies charge in 2026: published website, SEO, store, social and ads prices from 108 agency websites in eight cities, checked 29 October.

item.title: How to outsource web development to India: costs, contracts and time zones
item.dc:creator: Nakshatra Ranjan Saha
item.description: How to outsource web development to India: US and Indian prices side by side, time zone overlap, who owns the code, how to pay from abroad and a pilot project.

item.title: How to run a local SEO audit: a checklist for small businesses
item.dc:creator: Nakshatra Ranjan Saha
item.description: Run a local SEO audit in an afternoon: your Google Business Profile, matching details on Bing, Apple Maps, location pages, reviews, links and what to measure.

item.title: How much does a website cost in India in 2026?
item.dc:creator: Nakshatra Ranjan Saha
item.description: What a website costs in India in 2026: the build from ₹9,999, then domain, hosting, Shopify, payment gateway fees, email and GST, at each provider's own prices.

item.title: What does a small business website cost in 2026?
item.dc:creator: Nakshatra Ranjan Saha
item.description: What a small business website costs in 2026: the build from $149, then domain, hosting, Shopify, card fees, email and the ADA, at each provider's own prices.

item.title: How our free SEO audit works, from request to report
item.dc:creator: Nakshatra Ranjan Saha
item.description: How our free website SEO audit works: what the form asks, the safety checks, the ten pages we read, how findings are ranked, and a sample SEO audit report.

item.title: Technical SEO checklist for small business websites
item.dc:creator: Nakshatra Ranjan Saha
item.description: Twelve technical SEO checks for a small business website, in priority order: Search Console, indexing, robots.txt, sitemap, HTTPS, phones, speed and schema.

item.title: How to plan a business website before you hire anyone
item.dc:creator: Nakshatra Ranjan Saha
item.description: Plan a business website before you hire: set its one job, sketch pages for phones, keep the domain in your name and copy our one-page brief for quotes.

item.title: Logo vs brand identity: what you are paying for
item.dc:creator: Nakshatra Ranjan Saha
item.description: A logo is one mark; a brand identity is the system around it. See what each includes, who owns your logo in India and how to register it as a trademark.

item.title: Core Web Vitals explained for business owners
item.dc:creator: Nakshatra Ranjan Saha
item.description: What LCP, INP and CLS measure, the marks a page must hit to pass, how websites score on phones in India and what to ask your developer to fix.

item.title: Google Business Profile: a setup and upkeep guide for local businesses
item.dc:creator: Nakshatra Ranjan Saha
item.description: Set up and verify a Google Business Profile (formerly Google My Business) in India, ask for reviews within Google's rules and avoid suspensions.

item.title: What goes into a brand style guide, and how to use one
item.dc:creator: Nakshatra Ranjan Saha
item.description: What brand guidelines need: logo versions and platform sizes, colour pairs that pass contrast checks, font licences, Indian scripts, voice rules and templates.
